F0.attribution_distinction: Clean execution. High precision and faithfulness; establishes reference performance ceiling.

F1.attribution_distinction: Evidence Unavailable. Context precision drops to 0.0 because evidence is missing from corpus. Scalar score cannot distinguish whether evidence was unindexed (F1) vs demoted (F2).

F2.attribution_distinction: Evidence Ranked Out. Context precision drops to 0.0 due to distractor dominance. Evidence exists in index but missed cutoff; requires retriever tuning, not corpus re-indexing.

F3.attribution_distinction: Context Assembly Loss. Context precision appears normal (evidence retrieved), but context assembly dropped evidence. Faithfulness drops; fix requires context window / assembly prompt redesign.

F4.attribution_distinction: Contradictory Evidence. Context precision may be non-zero, but contradictory passage in context produces conflicting claims. Scalar precision masks internal evidence conflict.

F5.attribution_distinction: Unsupported Generation. Both context precision and evidence availability are intact, yet generator hallucinated ungrounded answer. Fix requires generator prompting/model swap.

interpretability_gap_summary: Analysis demonstrates that aggregate scalar metrics (Context Precision & Faithfulness) conflate distinct failure modes: for example, F1 (Evidence Unavailable) and F2 (Evidence Ranked Out) both yield 0.0 Context Precision despite requiring fundamentally different engineering remediations (corpus indexing vs retriever reranking). RAG-Autopsy attribution isolates the specific intervention stage.
